domain.description: Finite nonempty sets of points in the Euclidean plane in convex position.

quantifiers.domain: finite nonempty planar point sets in convex position
vertices p in A having no four other vertices at one common positive distance

statement.text: Does every finite set A of points in the plane in convex position have a vertex p for which there do not exist four other points of A all at the same positive distance from p?

title: Erdős Problem #97: equidistant vertices in convex polygons
